items.title: A gerbe over an algebraic space is the sheafification of the presheaf of isomorphism classes of its objects
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a gerbe over an algebraic space, that space is the sheafification of the presheaf of isomorphism classes of objects of the gerbe (author lemma at source lines 6090-6099, label lemma-gerbe-over-iso-classes). The proof (source lines 6101-6126) compares the two sheaves, proves surjectivity from the local existence of objects and injectivity from the local existence of isomorphisms supplied by the two clauses of the gerbe condition, and concludes by the injective-plus-surjective criterion for morphisms of sheaves (proof lines 6101-6125). The verification of the two sheaf-theoretic clauses from the gerbe condition is the content. H3.
